---
title: "A format that replaces Quarto's definitions"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  fake-typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

The format below replaces the definitions partial with a copy that has no
filename helper. The first block gets the window, and the second block
refuses it.

```{.python filename="a.py"}
x = 1 # <1>
```

1. A value.

```{.python filename="off.py" code-window-enabled="false"}
y = 2
```
